infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: KangaruRide records the route of a trip you are driving, so the office can verify distance against your odometer readings.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: KangaruRide lets you photograph the dashboard when you record an odometer reading. The photo is optional.
